# subtitle-tools

> Parse, convert and retime SRT and WebVTT subtitles: exact millisecond timing, tag and entity handling, shift and frame-rate retiming, and readability checks Python package `trysac-subtitle-tools`, import name `subtitle_tools`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
